title: Contrast Redis Fixed Window
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Contrast Redis Fixed Window.
learning_objectives: Explain contrast redis fixed window using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for contrast redis fixed window
Assess failure and operational limits of contrast redis fixed window
concepts_covered: A fixed window counts requests until a TTL expires; it does not smoothly refill fractional tokens.
RedisStore increments a key and sets PEXPIRE on count==1; Take compares count to burst and does not use rate.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
